entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: One of the five main Terisian Isles on Dominaria, west of Almaaz in the Ilesemare Sea, home of the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A college of scholars founded before the Brothers' War, later hidden as the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Co-founder of the College of Lat-Nam who helped establish the Third Path.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Co-founder of the college who kept its philosophy alive and led its sages to the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A scholar in contact with Drafna through letters.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: A hidden city of glossy black stone on mainland Terisiare where Drafna's sages created a sanctuary for mages.

entities.name: Vervamon the Elder
entities.description: Leader of a party that spent a night in the City of Shadows and fled after nightmares.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights the Battle of Lat-Nam, purges its corruption, loses her powers and becomes High Wizard of the Domains.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: A wizard who struck Greensleeves's brother with a fireball and was killed by her.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Leader of enemy wizards at the Battle of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: A companion who restored Greensleeves's sanity.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: An artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam whose secrets Greensleeves sought.

entities.name: Duler Angels
entities.description: Artifact angels living in the Duler Sanctum who guard Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Copper Conch
entities.description: Merfolk who guarded Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: A church strongly opposed to magic that raised an army against the Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: A school with a campus on Lat-Nam, taken over by dark forces in the second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A character who disposed of the Academy's archmage and took his place.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A figure who, after his resurrection, took control of the Academy with the Society of Mishra.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Creatures that attacked and destroyed the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The 4077 AR battle that marked Greensleeves's rise.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Lat-Nam lies.

events.summary: The College of Lat-Nam is destroyed in the Fall of the College of Lat-Nam and the land is poisoned.
events.quote: The college was destroyed in the Fall of the College of Lat-Nam and the land was poisoned

events.summary: After the Brothers' War the surviving scholars including Drafna leave Lat-Nam and settle in the City of Shadows as a hidden sanctuary.
events.quote: There, they settled down to create a hidden sanctuary for mages and scholars.

events.summary: Vervamon's party spends a night in the City of Shadows and flees after horrific nightmares.
events.quote: During their sleep, almost the entire party had horrific nightmares

events.summary: The School of the Unseen survives undetected through the Dark Age but must abandon the City of Shadows during the Ice Age.
events.quote: the School of the Unseen survived undetected into the Ice Age

events.summary: Soldevi Steam Beasts attack and destroy the School, leaving Lat-Nam without a school of magic; survivors travel to the Institute of Arcane Study.
events.quote: the school was attacked by Soldevi Steam Beasts and destroyed.

events.summary: Greensleeves and her party come to Lat-Nam in 4077 AR to uncover the secrets of the Stone Brain, battling and befriending its guardians.
events.quote: After a battle, Greensleeves befriended the guardians and led an excavation

events.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon after he hits her brother, traps the wizards and absorbs a Force of Nature, nearly losing herself until Kwam restores her sanity.
events.quote: Greensleeves, in a fit of grief and rage, killed Haakon

events.summary: Greensleeves pours her mana into Lat-Nam, purging its corruption and turning it into a paradise at the cost of her planeswalker powers; she becomes High Wizard of the Domains.
events.quote: This act cost her planeswalker powers , but secured her victory

events.summary: Geyadrone Dihada disposes of the Tolarian Academy's archmage, and Ertai and the Society of Mishra later turn it into a haven for dark research.
events.quote: Geyadrone Dihada disposed of the Academy's archmage and took his place.

relations.quote: Its co-founders Hurkyl and Drafna would help to establish the Third Path

relations.note: Co-founder who kept its philosophy alive.
relations.quote: Drafna kept the philosophy of the College of Lat-Nam alive

relations.note: She killed him in grief and rage.
relations.quote: Greensleeves, in a fit of grief and rage, killed Haakon

relations.note: One of the five main Terisian Isles.
relations.quote: Lat-Nam is one of the five main Terisian Isles on the plane Dominaria .
